component.name: net-merge
component.summary: Use all your internet connections at the same time

description.p: net-merge uses all your network adapters together: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, USB tethering and phone hotspots. Downloads, games and browsers get the speed of every connection added up.

It gives every new connection to one of your links, faster links get more, and a link with no internet gets none. It works for every app, with no proxy settings, no server and no VPN. If it crashes, your internet keeps working.
One connection always uses one link, so the gain comes from many connections at once, such as game downloads, browsers and download managers.
The tray icon needs a desktop with StatusNotifierItem support. On GNOME that is the AppIndicator extension, which Ubuntu already includes.

screenshot.caption: The tray menu shows each connection's speed and how many connections it carries
